segments.sn35.54:1.1: “Kathaṃ nu kho, bhante, jānato, kathaṃ passato, saṃyojanā pahīyantī”ti?
segments.sn35.54:1.2: “Cakkhuṃ kho, bhikkhu, aniccato jānato passato saṃyojanā pahīyanti.
segments.sn35.54:1.6: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato saṃyojanā pahīyanti.
segments.sn35.54:1.15: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato saṃyojanā pahīyanti.
segments.sn35.54:1.16: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, jānato evaṃ passato saṃyojanā pahīyantī”ti.

lines: Aniccato jānato passatoti dukkhānattavasenāpi jānato passato pahīyatiyeva, idaṃ pana aniccavasena kathite bujjhanakapuggalassa ajjhāsayena vuttaṃ.
Sabbupādānapariññāyāti sabbesaṃ catunnampi upādānānaṃ tīhi pariññāhi parijānanatthāya.
Avindiyaṃ vindati, vindiyaṃ na vindatīti katvā vijjāya paṭipakkhova avijjā.
Vijjāya uppannāya anavasesato avijjā pahīyati, taṃ dassento “vijjāti arahattamaggavijjā”ti āha.
Na kevalaṃ aniccānupassanāvaseneva maggavuṭṭhānaṃ, atha kho itarānupassanāvasenapīti dassento “dukkhā…pe… pahīyatiyevā”ti āha.
